concerns.text: Task T013 description contains a raw claim template '{{claim:c_61a9fcdd}}' instead of the actual implementation logic. This violates FR-007 (chi-squared fallback) by failing to specify the required Yates/Fisher logic, effectively weakening the requirement to a placeholder.

Task T014b enforces a 'hard constraint of [deferred] iterations'. The spec (FR-001) mandates 'at least 10,000 iterations'. Using '[deferred]' as a hard constraint in the task description weakens the requirement to an undefined value, violating the spec's minimum threshold.

Task T032 description is syntactically broken ('...Bootstrapped power estimation on real datasets must verify...'). It fails to clearly define the acceptance criterion for SC-003 (KS distance ≤ 0.10), risking a deliverable that does not verify the success criterion.

Task T005 is marked 'FAILED: unspecified' and references 'Constitution Principle VI, Principle V' without defining the schema. This violates Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) and VI (Simulation Fidelity) by failing to mandate the recording of seeds/config in the task deliverable.

Tasks T029a and T029c use raw claim templates ('{{claim:c_51a94046}}', '{{claim:c_aae0c4fb}}') instead of explicit dataset IDs or names. This violates FR-006 which requires specific datasets (Breast Cancer, Adult) and risks fetching incorrect data, weakening the validation requirement.
